points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 李光耀出生于新加坡一个富裕的华人家庭，接受英式教育。先后在莱佛士学院和剑桥大学学习，获得法学学位。这段经历使他精通英语，同时保留了深厚的中华文化根基，为他日后在多元种族的新加坡推行双语政策奠定了思想基础。在剑桥期间，他对英国政治制度有了深入了解，并开始思考殖民地国家的独立问题。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a wealthy Peranakan Chinese family in Singapore, Lee received a British-style education. He studied at Raffles College and later at Cambridge University, where he earned a law degree. This period equipped him with fluency in English while maintaining deep cultural roots in Chinese heritage, laying the foundation for his later bilingual policy in multicultural Singapore. At Cambridge, he gained firsthand knowledge of British political systems and began contemplating independence for colonial nations.

points.title: 法律生涯与政治启蒙
points.description: 二战期间，李光耀目睹日本占领新加坡，这段经历深刻影响了他对国家安全的看法。战后，他成为执业律师，同时积极参与政治活动。1954年，他与一群志同道合的伙伴共同创立了人民行动党(PAP)，提出结束殖民统治、实现自治的主张。这一时期，他展现出卓越的辩论才能和政治远见，开始为新加坡的未来规划蓝图。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Lee witnessed the Japanese occupation of Singapore, an experience that profoundly shaped his views on national security. Post-war, he became a practicing lawyer while actively engaging in politics. In 1954, he co-founded the People's Action Party (PAP) with like-minded individuals, advocating for an end to colonial rule and self-governance. During this period, he demonstrated exceptional oratory skills and political foresight, beginning to map out Singapore's future.

points.title: 自治之路
points.description: 1955年，李光耀当选立法议会议员，开始正式步入政坛。1959年，人民行动党赢得大选，李光耀成为新加坡首任自治政府总理。在这一时期，他面临严峻挑战：种族冲突、经济落后、住房短缺和社会动荡。他迅速采取行动，推动多项改革，包括改善种族关系、发展经济和解决住房问题，为新加坡独立后的稳定发展奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1955, Lee was elected to the Legislative Assembly, formally entering politics. By 1959, the PAP won the general election, and Lee became Singapore's first Prime Minister of the self-governing state. During this period, he faced formidable challenges: racial tensions, economic underdevelopment, housing shortages, and social unrest. He swiftly implemented reforms addressing inter-ethnic relations, economic development, and housing issues, laying the groundwork for Singapore's stability after independence.

points.title: 马来西亚联邦时期
points.description: 1963年，新加坡与马来亚、沙巴和砂拉越合并成立马来西亚联邦。李光耀担任新加坡州总理。然而，种族政治矛盾迅速激化，李光耀与马来亚首相东姑阿都拉曼关系紧张。1965年8月9日，新加坡被迫退出马来西亚，成为一个独立国家。这一挫折成为李光耀政治生涯中的重大转折点，促使他更加坚定地推行务实主义政策，将新加坡打造为亚洲经济奇迹。
points.descriptionEn: In 1963, Singapore merged with Malaya, Sabah, and Sarawak to form the Federation of Malaysia, with Lee serving as Singapore's state chief minister. However, racial political tensions quickly escalated, and Lee's relationship with Malaysian Prime Minister Tunku Abdul Rahman deteriorated. On August 9, 1965, Singapore was expelled from Malaysia, becoming an independent nation. This setback marked a turning point in Lee's political career, leading him to more firmly pursue pragmatic policies that would transform Singapore into the Asian economic miracle.

points.title: 建国总理
points.description: 作为新加坡首任总理，李光耀领导国家度过了最艰难的建国初期。他推行了一系列具有远见卓识的政策：吸引外资发展工业、建立裕廊工业区、推行住房发展计划(HDB)、实施双语教育政策、严厉打击犯罪和腐败。他建立了强大的国家机器，同时保持政治稳定。这一时期，新加坡从一个资源匮乏的小国发展成为亚洲四小龙之一，创造了经济奇迹。李光耀的实用主义治国理念得到充分体现，他强调'亚洲价值观'与西方民主制度的结合。
points.descriptionEn: As Singapore's first Prime Minister, Lee led the nation through its most challenging early years. He implemented visionary policies: attracting foreign investment for industrial development, establishing the Jurong Industrial Estate, launching the Housing Development Board (HDB) program, implementing bilingual education, and strictly combating crime and corruption. He built a strong state apparatus while maintaining political stability. During this period, Singapore transformed from a resource-poor island nation into one of the Asian Tigers, creating an economic miracle. Lee's pragmatic governance philosophy was fully manifested, emphasizing a blend of 'Asian values' with Western democratic institutions.

points.title: 资政岁月
points.description: 1990年，李光耀将总理职位交给吴作栋，但留任内阁资政，继续对新加坡政治产生重大影响。他专注于国际事务，担任多个国际组织的顾问，为新加坡在国际舞台上争取话语权。同时，他继续指导新加坡的政策方向，特别是在经济转型和区域安全方面。2011年，人民行动党赢得大选但得票率降至历史最低，李光耀逐渐淡出公众视野，于2015年3月23日逝世，享年91岁。他的逝世标志着新加坡建国一代的落幕，但他的政治遗产至今仍深刻影响着新加坡的发展方向。
points.descriptionEn: In 1990, Lee handed over the premiership to Goh Chok Tong but remained as Senior Minister, continuing to exert significant influence on Singapore's politics. He focused on international affairs, serving as an advisor to various international organizations and securing a voice for Singapore on the global stage. Simultaneously, he continued to guide Singapore's policy direction, particularly in economic transformation and regional security. In 2011, when the PAP won elections with its lowest-ever vote share, Lee gradually receded from public view. He passed away on March 23, 2015, at age 91. His death marked the end of Singapore's founding generation, but his political legacy continues to profoundly influence the nation's development path.

supporter.zh: 李光耀被视为新加坡的国父和现代新加坡的缔造者。支持者赞扬他卓越的领导才能和远见卓识，将一个资源匮乏的小岛发展成为亚洲最繁荣的国家之一。他推行的务实主义政策、严厉的反腐败措施和高效的经济管理为新加坡奠定了坚实基础。李光耀强调的'亚洲价值观'和精英治国理念，使新加坡在保持政治稳定的同时实现了经济奇迹，为发展中国家提供了成功范例。
supporter.en: Lee Kuan Yew is regarded as the founding father of modern Singapore and the architect of the nation's success. Supporters praise his exceptional leadership and foresight in transforming a resource-poor island into one of Asia's most prosperous nations. His pragmatic policies, stringent anti-corruption measures, and efficient economic management laid a solid foundation for Singapore. The 'Asian values' and meritocracy he emphasized enabled Singapore to achieve an economic miracle while maintaining political stability, providing a successful model for developing nations.

critic.zh: 批评者认为李光耀的统治过于威权，限制公民自由和政治多元化。他长期执政期间，人民行动党几乎垄断政治权力，反对声音受到压制。批评者指出，新加坡的快速发展是以牺牲民主权利为代价的，包括言论自由、集会自由和新闻自由。此外，李光耀对政治异见者的严厉打压、对媒体的控制以及对反对党的限制，被批评为违背民主原则。他的精英治国理念也被批评为忽视了普通民众的声音和需求。
critic.en: Critics argue that Lee's rule was overly authoritarian, restricting civil liberties and political pluralism. During his long tenure, the People's Action Party nearly monopolized political power, and dissenting voices were suppressed. Critics contend that Singapore's rapid development came at the cost of democratic rights, including freedom of speech, assembly, and press. Additionally, Lee's harsh treatment of political dissidents, control of media, and restrictions on opposition parties are criticized as violating democratic principles. His meritocracy-based governance is also criticized for neglecting the voices and needs of ordinary citizens.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，李光耀被视为一位复杂而矛盾的政治人物。他被公认为20世纪最具影响力的亚洲领导人之一，其治国理念和实践被广泛研究。学术界普遍承认他成功带领新加坡实现经济转型和社会稳定，同时也对其威权统治方式持批判态度。在流行文化中，李光耀常被描绘为'亚洲价值观'的代表人物，他的形象既被尊崇也被争议。他的政治遗产至今仍是新加坡国内外讨论的焦点，反映了亚洲现代化进程中的复杂性和多样性。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Lee Kuan Yew is viewed as a complex and contradictory political figure. He is widely recognized as one of the most influential Asian leaders of the 20th century, with his governance philosophy and practices extensively studied. Academia generally acknowledges his success in leading Singapore through economic transformation and social stability while maintaining a critical perspective on his authoritarian rule. In popular culture, Lee is often portrayed as a representative of 'Asian values,' with his image both revered and controversial. His political legacy remains a focal point of discussion in Singapore and internationally, reflecting the complexities and diversity of Asia's modernization process.

self.zh: 我从不相信乌托邦。我从不相信乌托邦式的解决方案。我相信的是务实、实用、有效的东西。
self.en: I don't believe in Utopias. I don't believe in Utopian solutions. I believe in what is practical, what is workable, what is effective.

others.zh: 李光耀是一位实用主义者，他明白新加坡必须依靠自己的才能和努力才能生存。他建立了高效、廉洁的政府，创造了经济奇迹，但也限制了政治自由。
others.en: Lee Kuan Yew was a pragmatist who understood that Singapore had to rely on its own talents and efforts to survive. He built an efficient, incorruptible government and created an economic miracle, but at the cost of political liberties.
